ABOUT AXELA LTD.

Connecting Trade, Product Supply and Commercial Advisory

AXELA LTD. works at the intersection of international trade, product supply and commercial advisory. Our role is to help identify opportunities, connect relevant counterparties, and coordinate the commercial steps required to move complex physical transactions forward.

We aim to build enduring business relationships founded on transparent communication, professional conduct, strict confidentiality, and a practical, on-the-ground understanding of buyer and supplier requirements across Bangladesh and international markets.

“Operating as a strategic commercial bridge — facilitating cross-border commodity flow, institutional supply agreements, and high-value investment origination.”

INSTITUTIONAL TRADE VERIFICATION PROTOCOL

Each enquiry is assessed individually. Product name, grade specifications, country of origin, volume, packing format, delivery schedule, Incoterm (FOB, CFR, CIF), accredited inspection requirements (SGS / Saybolt), and verified payment terms (DLC / SBLC) must be confirmed prior to issuing firm commercial offers.

OPERATING MODEL

Our Disciplined Working Approach

A structured five-stage commercial execution pipeline engineered to protect counterparty integrity, streamline trade documentation, and ensure contractual certainty.

01
PHASE 01 • SCOPE

Understand the Requirement

Confirm product or project scope, technical specifications, volume, discharge port, delivery timeline, and commercial baseline parameters.

02
PHASE 02 • ORIGINATION

Identify Counterparties

Engage qualified suppliers, refineries, verified domestic buyers, project sponsors, or institutional investors under strict mandate alignment.

03
PHASE 03 • STRUCTURING

Clarify Commercial Terms

Structure pricing benchmarks, Incoterms delivery conditions, banking instruments, inspection protocols, and mutual contractual obligations.

04
PHASE 04 • COORDINATION

Coordinate the Process

Coordinate trade documentation, laytime monitoring, shipping schedule logistics, and operational follow-up through completion.

05
PHASE 05 • GOVERNANCE

Maintain High Standards

Promote strict confidentiality, transparent communication, ethical conduct, and compliance with applicable legal and trade regulations.
